analysis_plan: paired permutation test (scipy.stats.permutation_test, permutation_type=samples) on the 8 per-task mean percentages for R vs M-block (the only pre-registered comparison at this pilot size -- A is explicitly OUT of this pilot's budget, see sample_size_arithmetic); bootstrap 95% CI (scipy.stats.bootstrap) on each arm's mean task percentage; clustered SE by task (Anthropic arXiv 2411.00640 Eq. 4). No Holm correction needed (single comparison). Report R vs M-block, losses first, as v1/v2/v3 did. This is explicitly a PILOT (see sample_size_arithmetic): report the measured effect and its CI, but do not call a null result 'no effect' -- state the MDE this n can actually detect, honestly, beside it.
sample_size_arithmetic: NOT a powered confirmatory design -- a PILOT, sized by a fixed time budget, not by the stated MDE. Wave G's shared rule and this task's brief fix the budget directly: v1's M+J arm measured ~10 min/run (results-mj.md); at 2 arms (R, M-block) x 8 tasks x 3 epochs = 48 runs x ~10 min = ~8 hours, the same arithmetic the brief states verbatim. A is deliberately EXCLUDED from this pilot (adding it would be 3 arms x 8 x 3 = 72 runs, ~12h, over budget) -- it may be added later as a secondary arm if Raymond extends the budget; this spec's primary (and only pre-registered) comparison is R vs M-block. Honest power check, COMPUTED not asserted (evals/inspect/dcbench_eval/stats.sample_size_for_mde used in reverse -- TTestPower().solve_power(nobs=3, alpha=0.05, power=0.8) -> effect_size, then mde = effect_size * sd, same measured per-task-diff sd's protocol-v3 computed from T63's real 72 runs: sd(R-M)=23.05): at runs_per_arm_per_task=3 (same epoch count as v1, NOT v3's n=21), the minimum detectable effect on the primary R vs M-block comparison at 80% power / alpha=0.05 is approximately 75 POINTS (computed 2026-11-04, tasks/T97-benchmark-v4-blocking/4 log/prior-art.md has the exact calc) -- i.e. this 48-run pilot can only reliably detect a swing roughly 5x larger than v1's own largest pairwise effect (A-M, +7.8) and ~31x larger than v1's measured R-M difference (+2.4). This pilot is explicitly NOT powered to confirm or rule out a real D102 effect; it exists to (a) prove the blocking mechanism actually fires in a real run (the smoke, already done, see evidence.md) and (b) produce an early, honestly-captioned signal + CI, not a significance claim either way. Reaching v3's own MDE=15 on this SAME R-M comparison still needs n=21 runs/arm/task (504 scored runs total for 2 arms), exactly as protocol-v3 already computed; this pilot does not change that number, it only tests the NEW blocking mechanism at a budget Raymond can approve without first committing to the full 21x run.
